Din count mat karo—din ko count banado.
Fear ko future decide mat karne do.
"Dekhne ka tareeqa badlo, nazar bhi badlegi."
"Sun shine kare ya na kare—tumko keep going karna hai."
Tumhari beliefs tumhari reality create karti hain.
"Creativity khatam nahi hoti—jitna use, utna zyada."
Apne actions ko louder banao.
Main kabhi nahi haarte. Ya to main jeetata hun, ya seekhta hun.
Tumhari limit imagination hai.
"Future unka hai jo tayari karte hain."
"Success mindset hai, destination nahi."
